Roots

Built on strong foundations

Every specialisation above the surface depends on what sits below it. These six fundamentals are where the rest of the work draws from.

  • Accounting
  • Financial Analysis
  • Commercial Finance
  • Working Capital
  • Trade Finance
  • Tax & Compliance

These fundamentals form the foundation of my finance career. Accounting discipline and financial analysis came first; commercial finance, working capital and trade finance built on them through day-to-day operating work.

Tax and compliance run alongside all of it. The combination is what allows a number in a report to be traced back to a transaction, a contract clause, or a regulatory requirement.

Approach

About my approach

An analytical Corporate Finance professional and CMA Finalist with experience across Financial Planning & Analysis, Working Capital Management, Global Trade Finance, Accounting, and Corporate Taxation. The work moves through three stages.

01

Analyze

Understand the numbers and identify patterns — variance, ageing, cash movement, and what is actually driving each of them.

02

Optimize

Improve processes, working capital and reporting so that decisions rest on a cleaner, faster and more reliable base.

03

Enable

Use technology and automation to support better decisions — dashboards, queries and models that remove manual effort.

Case Studies

Selected work

Four areas of work where analysis, process and technology came together.

Cash Flow & Variance Modeling

Operating decisions needed a forward view of cash and a clear reading of where costs were drifting from plan.

WHAT I WORKED ON

Built dynamic cash inflow models, rolling forecasts, and automated cost variance frameworks to analyse operational trends and support working capital decisions.

OUTCOME

Cash position and variance drivers became reviewable on a rolling basis instead of being reconstructed each cycle.

  • FP&A
  • Excel
  • Power Query
  • Cash Flow Modeling

Power BI Executive Dashboards

Financial data sat across multiple systems and had to be assembled manually before management could read it.

WHAT I WORKED ON

Developed interactive Power BI dashboards and automated data pipelines to transform complex multi-source financial data into executive KPI reporting.

OUTCOME

Management reporting moved from assembled spreadsheets to a refreshable dashboard view of the same KPIs.

  • Power BI
  • DAX
  • ETL
  • MIS Reporting

Global Trade Finance Operations

Cross-border transactions carry documentation and regulatory steps that must line up exactly, at each bank and each authority.

WHAT I WORKED ON

Managed cross-border banking, import-export documentation, FEMA/RBI compliance, EDPMS/IDPMS processes, Form A2, Form 15CA/CB and customs documentation.

OUTCOME

Trade transactions and their regulatory reporting were handled as one controlled sequence rather than separate handoffs.

  • International Finance
  • FEMA
  • RBI Compliance
  • DGFT
  • ICEGATE

    • Receivables & Working Capital Analytics

    Collections depend on knowing which invoices are ageing, why they are disputed, and what that does to cash conversion.

    WHAT I WORKED ON

    Managed multi-crore accounts receivable/payable portfolios, performed ageing analysis, resolved billing disputes and commercial deductions, and supported DSO reduction initiatives.

    OUTCOME

    Ageing, disputes and collection follow-up were tracked against a single view of the receivables position.

    • Accounts Receivable/Payable
    • Working Capital
    • Finance Analytics
